brief.positioning_guardrail: Premium and technically credible, not luxury-fashion.

shared_presentation_rules.placeholder_disclosure: The official brand name was not supplied; all name and initial treatments are provisional.

directions.name: Registered Edge
directions.strategic_idea: Measured planes aligned to a single registration datum.
directions.identity_architecture: Independent geometric symbol plus widely tracked uppercase wordmark.
directions.mark_construction: Two offset surface planes crossed by one vertical datum line.
directions.system_extension: The datum line can organize covers, range tabs and technical layouts.
directions.small_size_result: Proposed icon minimum is 16 px; the paired planes and accent line remain distinguishable.
directions.sample_book_result: Compact mark, range datum stripe and dark specification-led cover architecture.

directions.name: Modular Field
directions.strategic_idea: A repeatable kit in which four corner modules frame a central signal.
directions.identity_architecture: Expandable modular symbol plus approachable lowercase wordmark.
directions.mark_construction: Four right-angle modules surround one contrasting square.
directions.system_extension: Modules become range codes, repeat patterns, shelf navigation and spatial graphics.
directions.small_size_result: Proposed icon minimum is 16 px; the four corners and centre remain readable.
directions.sample_book_result: Light swatch-friendly cover, coded centre tile and modular crop system.

directions.name: Cutline Wordmark
directions.strategic_idea: The brand name itself carries a calibrated cut inspired by machining and section drawings.
directions.identity_architecture: Name-led custom wordmark with a cut initial as the compact mark.
directions.mark_construction: A bold provisional initial interrupted by the same horizontal cut used across the wordmark.
directions.system_extension: The cutline aligns typography, range metadata, covers and signage.
directions.small_size_result: Proposed initial minimum is 16 px; the cut remains visible as a one-pixel interruption.
directions.sample_book_result: High-impact editorial cover with overscale initial and aligned range data.
directions.dependency: The official name and first letter must be known before this direction can be accurately judged as a final wordmark.

human_checkpoint.prompt: Select Direction 01, 02 or 03 before any refinement or final identity-starter production.
